Container.Name: Polydock
Container.Overview: Self-hosted 3D print library: scans your STL, 3MF, OBJ and STEP files in place, shows them in 3D, paints them for multi-material printing and opens them in Bambu Studio, OrcaSlicer or PrusaSlicer.

Config.Name: Models
Config.Description: Your model files. Read-only by default: Polydock never changes them. Set to rw to get a real trash.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, thumbnails and imported files. Back this up.

Config.Name: Libraries
Config.Description: Folders to scan inside the container, separated by ':' (Name=/library/path to name them), or s3://bucket/prefix

Config.Name: S3 endpoint
Config.Description: Only for a library in S3-compatible storage

Config.Name: S3 region
Config.Description: Only for a library in S3-compatible storage

Config.Name: S3 access key
Config.Description: Only for a library in S3-compatible storage

Config.Name: S3 secret key
Config.Description: Only for a library in S3-compatible storage
